chunks: From him, from al-Mīthamī and others, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I asked him about a man who prayed Zuhr when the sun had declined. He said: “There is no problem with it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no objection to it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray Zuhr when the sun declines from the meridian?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the time of salat. It indicates that performing the Zuhr prayer at the time when the sun has declined from the meridian is permissible and unobjectionable.
